description: Java class 'MockACECluster' which extends 'MockCluster' and provides simulation functionality for an ACE security panel within a Zigbee cluster framework. It handles commands, status parsing, and includes nested enums and constants reflective of security panel states.
external_methods: new ArmCommandEvent(String, int, ArmMode, String, byte).send()
new ClusterCommandEvent(String, int, int, boolean, int).send()

classes.name: MockACECluster
classes.description: A mock class simulating an ACE security device cluster with methods for requesting status, handling commands, and managing panel states.

classes.name: MockACECluster.ArmMode
classes.description: Enum representing different arm modes (DISARM, ARM_DAY, ARM_NIGHT, ARM_ALL) with methods to convert to/from byte values.

classes.name: MockACECluster.AlarmStatus
classes.description: Constants representing possible alarm statuses (NO_ALARM, BURGLAR, FIRE, etc.).

classes.name: MockACECluster.PanelStatus
classes.description: Constants representing various panel statuses (DISARMED, ARMED_STAY, ARMED_NIGHT, etc.).

methods.name: requestPanelStateChange
methods.description: Simulates a request to change panel state using an access code and arm mode.

methods.name: parsePanelStatus
methods.description: Parses the payload received for panel status updates and logs errors or info.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming command messages based on command ID and payload, updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: isAudible
methods.description: Indicates whether the alarm is set to audible.
